blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police are investigating a shooting incident reported in Barangay Tabon-Tabon, Baco, Oriental Mindoro, early Friday, Oct. 16. The Baco Municipal Police Station said it received a call from a concerned citizen reporting the incident and immediately dispatched personnel to verify the report and respond to the scene. READ: Classes suspended in Mindoro town as flooding hits roads In a statement, police said investigators were still determining the circumstances surrounding the shooting, which occurred at 3 a.m. and identifying those involved.
